title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 112 ]

blocks.text: As a result of the economy, there aren't many jobs available right now. But don't be discouraged because there are somethings you can try. Have you considered taking night classes to train for another kind of job? Many workers learn new skills while keeping their regular jobs. Another possibility is looking for a different type of job in your present company. Finally, even if there are no other jobs around, be sure to relax. Take time out to do things you enjoy after work in order to reduce the stress you experience during your workday.

readingSentences.english: As a result of the economy, there aren't many jobs available right now.
readingSentences.korean: 경제(문제)결과로, 당장 얻을 수 있는 일자리가 많지 않다.

readingSentences.english: But don't be discouraged because there are somethings you can try.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 당신이 시도할 수 있는 것들이 있으니 낙심하지 마라.

readingSentences.english: Have you considered taking night classes to train for another kind of job?
readingSentences.korean: 다른 종류의 일거리를 위해 훈련하기 위해 야간 과정을 취하려고 고려해 본적이 있는가?

readingSentences.english: Many workers learn new skills while keeping their regular jobs.
readingSentences.korean: 많은 근로자들이 그들의 정규적인 직업을 유지하면서 새로운 기술을 배운다.

readingSentences.english: Another possibility is looking for a different type of job in your present company.
readingSentences.korean: 또 다른 방법은 현재의 회사에서 다른 형태의 일거리를 찾아보는 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Finally, even if there are no other jobs around, be sure to relax.
readingSentences.korean: 마지막으로, 주변에 다른 일자리가 없다 하더라도, 마음을 편히 먹어라.

readingSentences.english: Take time out to do things you enjoy after work in order to reduce the stress you experience during your workday.
readingSentences.korean: 일하는 날 동안에 경험한 스트래스를 감소시키기 위해서 일 후에 즐길 수 있는 것들을 위해 시간을 때어 둬라.
